test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**promising.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given passage, the subject of the passage i.e. the race faced an accident.
 
• **In the accident he lost his vision and thus his career also came to an end.**
 
• **Now, the blank 2 will explain the nature of his career and explain how good it was.**
 
• Among the given options, **the correct word to use would be "promising."**
 
 
• "Promising" means something showing signs of being very good or successful.
 
• Example: She is a promising young writer.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
